dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-toned rings with high-contrast outer perimeters transitioning into dark-toned centers are visible across the dorsal and lateral surfaces.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Sparse distribution of high-intensity white pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily localized in the anterior-dorsal region and interspersed between larger annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal 'O'-shaped annuli form a distinct triangular spatial relationship on the upper mid-body.

other_distinctive_markers: The lateral surface exhibits an interlocking texture topology where several large annuli are clustered closely, creating a 'chain-link' visual pattern.
